# Disable GHA cache for test vectors

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

It seems that caching the submodules is much slower than simply checking them out. Additionally this PR introduces selective checkout which should be even faster.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Streamlined CI test workflow by removing a redundant setup job.
  * Switched to per-entry submodule handling so each run fetches only the required test vectors.
  * Replaced SSH submodule access with HTTPS for improved compatibility.
  * Simplified fallback path by removing cached-restoration and using a single checkout plus targeted submodule fetch.

<sub>✏️ Tip: You can customize this high-level summary in your review settings.</sub>

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The workflow was refactored to remove the separate setup-test-vectors job and its dependency. The test-vectors job matrix now includes a per-entry `submodule` field. Checkout no longer uses `submodules: true`; instead a new step initializes only the required submodule per matrix entry, converting SSH URLs to HTTPS when fetching. Fallback cache/checkout steps that previously restored and checked out all submodules were removed and replaced by the single-checkout plus per-entry submodule fetch approach.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~22 minutes

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#808: Adds w3f-davxy 0.7.2 test vectors and related submodule checkout logic; overlaps with the per-submodule fetch changes.
